description: Capture something in the project’s notes/triage hub without stopping to file a full task. Use `triage` for work you spot that should be scheduled later ("this file is huge, refactor it"), `followup` for something to do after this change merges, `todo` for a checklist item, or `note` for a plain observation. The human sees it in the Notes tab and can promote it into a real task in one click.
name: dispatch_note
title: Add a note or triage item
